sourcePolicy: Curriculum excerpts: Course of Study LOD / MEXT, CC BY 4.0. Questions, dependency edges and simulator: original demo data.
purpose: Illustrate how learning routes change under explicit simulated learning and forgetting assumptions. Not evidence of real educational effectiveness.
jevInput: Only released candidate skills and observed answer history; no hidden mastery, pupil profile or ground truth diagnosis.
candidatePolicy: Code constructs up to four candidates. Jev chooses only among them. Single-candidate weeks require no inference.
comparison: Identical simulator coefficients, starting states, exercise budget and seeded random streams. Different choices change future states. One seed, four authored profiles; no statistical superiority claim.
observation: Past pass count differs from estimated current retention and internal simulated mastery. Both are exposed separately in the UI.
fees: Input token usage times $0.042 per million is an estimate, not an invoice. Browser playback makes no inference calls.
